name: Foldable Spiral Clipboard Folio with Zipper Pouch (Purple)
seoTitle: Purple Clipboard Folio Organizer for Nurses
metaDescription: A purple foldable spiral clipboard folio with a zipper pouch, ten folder pockets, a notepad, and stickers, a fun organizer for nurses and students.
summary: A purple clipboard folio with a zipper pouch, folder pockets, and stickers, an organized and fun gift for nurses who love their planners.
whyItWorks: Some nurses run on lists, color coding, and a planner that is close to sacred. For that person, a clipboard folio with a zipper pouch, five plastic folders with ten pockets, and a refillable lined notepad is a happy gift. It turns a stack of loose papers into something orderly, and the hardcover protects it all in a work bag.

The zipper pouch is handy for pens, highlighters, badge cards, or a spare charger, so the small things stop sinking to the bottom of a tote. Thirty nine stickers add a playful touch for labeling sections or just decorating. It makes sense for nursing students keeping class and clinical material apart, nurse educators, and home health or school nurses who move between locations with paperwork. Purple gives it a cheerful look without being loud. Pair it with a set of colored pens and some sticky tabs for a gift that feels thought through.
goodToKnow: At 11 by 8.5 inches it is a desk and bag item, not a pocket clipboard.
Check the listing for notepad refill options.
The stickers are general, so add nurse themed ones for a personal touch.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes, the folders and pockets make it easy to keep different courses and clinical paperwork separate.

faq.q: Will a floor nurse use it on shift?
faq.a: It is probably too large for bedside work. It suits students, educators, and nurses with office or travel based roles better.
